desc:
A Realistic And Hardcore VR Sword Fighting Game.

GLADIATOR VR is in Paid Early Access. Once the game is finished ill release it for free so everyone can play it.

Controls
Left Joystick: Movement
Right Joystick: Crouch
Grip: Grab Items, Climb Walls, Grab Other Players

Swinging Arms: Sprinting
Swinging Arms + Crouch: Sliding


Combat Explained:
Swinging Requires Stamina.
Half Swording And Blocking Swings Restore Stamina.
Half Swording And Hitting A Block Drains Stamina.
No Stamina = Slowed Movement And Tracking.
Pierce Head = Instant Win.

Credits/Inspiration:
CROSSFADE VR 
OPPOSER VR
Mortem Metallum
Blade And Sorcery
Walking Dead S&S

Note: Nothing you see in game is finalized. Core features of the game can break at any given moment.
